AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Recording Compressor encodes video and audio on this device with FFmpeg or Media3 and can combine a picture or video with a soundtrack. Operational Patterns: - Call describeCapabilities first to learn allowed enum values and whether library access is granted. - If library access is off, call requestLibraryAccess and ask the user to enable Device library access and choose Allow all. - Prefer compressNow(uriOrPath, settings, wait=true) for a single file. - For several files, listDeviceMedia with relativePath or date filters, then importDeviceMediaBatch, then startReadyJobs and waitForQueue. - Use cloneJob for a second encode of the same source. Use retryJob after FAILED or CANCELLED. - waitForJob and waitForQueue block at most 180 seconds; if timedOut is true, call them again. - shareOutput or openOutput when a job SUCCEEDED. discardJob removes history only. Constraints: - Do not record the screen, delete gallery files, or wipe all history. - Do not return or request media bytes. Job records omit source and output URIs. - Extra FFmpeg arguments cannot add inputs, paths, or filter_complex.
